source_calculus.objects: Ordered finite Boolean registers; logical k-bit data with m clean zero work bits, k>=1.
primitive_gates: CNOT with distinct control and target
Toffoli with two distinct controls and a distinct target
source_calculus.formation: Finite chronological gate words; identity word, sequential concatenation and disjoint register placement.
source_calculus.inverse: Reverse the word; each primitive is an involution.
source_calculus.allowed_workspace: At most max(k-3,0) clean work bits for the compiled k-bit permutation; extra registers explicitly declared for graph construction.
forbidden: arbitrary permutation as a primitive gate

target_class.carrier: B_k={0,1}^k for every integer k>=1, lexicographically/integer labelled with least significant bit index 0.
target_class.arrows: Every bijection f:B_k->B_k supplied as a complete finite table satisfying bijectivity; table is specification, not an execution primitive.
target_class.identity: Extensional equality on all inputs; proof objects for finite equality are propositional at this scope.
target_class.continuations: All finite words of specified bijections of B_k and all Boolean predicates on B_k; predicates are specified readouts, not source gates.
target_class.resources: Gate count and explicit initialized workspace; no physical cost or clock units.

third_presentation.carrier: C_f={(x,y) in B_k x B_k | y=f(x)} with both ordered coordinate registers retained.
third_presentation.realization: Graph preparation copies x by CNOT into a clean second register then applies the compiled f to that register. Graph recovery uncomputes the prepared register; coordinate projections alone are not claimed reversible on the ambient product.
third_presentation.common_root: The source-typed marked pair m=(a,b) in C_f, with ac(a)=bc(b)=m; not a geometric barycenter or an arbitrary terminal space.
third_presentation.nonvacuity: C_f retains both input and output with their coordinate roles and constraint. It is abstractly equivalent to B_k, but its retained presentation and constructive graph preparation are explicit, not a fresh name for A.

conjectures.statement: For every k>=1, every bijection f:B_k->B_k and every mark a, a terminating uniform compiler using only the frozen source gates constructs f and f^-1 with clean workspace, the graph presentation and common marked root, both full-input triangle returns, coherent composition at the extensional interface, and exact transport of every declared continuation/readout.
conjectures.candidate_method: Decompose the permutation into transpositions; lower each transposition through Gray-path adjacent swaps; lower each adjacent swap to NOT/CNOT/Toffoli with clean workspace.
conjectures.acceptance: General constructive correctness/termination/resource proof plus source-bound regression and mutation controls; bounded tests alone do not close the all-k claim.
conjectures.falsifier: An input bijection with no allowed clean implementation within the stated workspace bound, or a failed required full-input/composition/graph/continuation equation in the claimed compiler.
conjectures.verification_target: Written uniform constructive mathematics plus exact finite circuit checks; proof-assistant kernel verification is a separate level.

conjectures.statement: The projection retaining only a completed output value, or only the complete extensional permutation table, has no decoder recovering every source gate word: distinct allowed words can have the same action and output.
conjectures.falsifier: A decoder recovering both the empty identity word and a two-NOT identity word from their identical projected action.
conjectures.scope: Construction-history recovery, not failure to recover x from f(x) when f^-1 is retained; not every historical distinction is required by extensional target continuations.
